messages:
marie_sales: quick heads-up — Novabank asked for SOC2 artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation as part of their POC acceptance. deadline: EOD Friday if possible. cc @sam_security @amy_legal :eyes:

sam_security: noted. can you confirm scope? do they want the full SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter, or only the security controls mapping? also need to know if they require pen-test details or just a signed external-pen-test attestation (no vuln details).

marie_sales: they said 'SOC2 evidence set + pen-test letter' — their procurement team will confirm exact docs today but assumed full report + pen-test attestation. i'll ping their security contact.

kevin_se: for the POC demo we need a sandbox tenant and an IDP SAML test account. also, if they want dedicated capacity for data isolation during POC, pricing team needs to quote. proposed POC window: next wed/thurs.

jordan_infra: FYI: if customer needs KMS/HSM-backed keys (required for some banks) that pushes them to Private on-prem or VPC with customer-managed KMS. can give rough delta vs hosted in the quote.

amy_legal: pen-test attestation: we have a standard template, but external pen-test vendors often require a limited-disclosure addendum. i can prepare the attestation and the NDA language — need the name of the third-party tester and whether Novabank will receive vuln details.

marie_sales: their security lead is alex.illinois@novabank.com — said they prefer an attestation (no detailed vuln list), but procurement might ask for vendor details.

sam_security: sounds good. checklist from our side (quick):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PII)
- SOC2 bridge letter (if Type II not current within 12 months)
- Pen-test attestation (signed)
- Network architecture diagram + data flow
- KMS/HSM architecture + control evidence (rotation policies, roles)
- SSO/SAML metadata + IdP proof of test

kevin_se: sharing the SAML snippet we usually give to banks for the POC (ask alex to import):
```
EntityID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/novabank
ACS: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
```

sam_security: thanks. amy — do you need me to redact anything in the SOC2 report before sharing? we usually remove example client names and sensitive infra IPs.

amy_legal: yes please redact client identifiers and any third-party contact info. also include a short statement: "This attestation is provided for the exclusive use of Novabank for their internal evaluation of Redwood Inference." i'll draft.

ops_bot: uploaded templates and folder: https://redwood.internal/sales/evidence/novabank (contains: soc2-redacted-template.pdf, pen-test-attestation-template.pdf, network-diagram-template.vsdx) :file_folder:

marie_sales: perfect — plan: amy to draft pen-test attestation + NDA language by EOD today; sam to prep redacted SOC2 and network diagram; kevin to confirm POC dates and send SAML snippet to alex; jordan to include pricing delta for Private/KMS. i'll assemble response to Novabank and send.

kevin_se: i'll put tentative slots in calendar for Wed/Thu and share zoom.

jordan_infra: quick pricing note to include in proposal: hosted (shared) POC — no infra uplift; Private w/ customer-managed KMS — add ~$12k/month (estimate) for reserved nodes + KMS integration labor. we'll refine after scope call.

marie_sales: timeline & owners set. anyone object to EOD Friday delivery?

sam_security: ok from infra/security side, may need follow-up clarifications but EOD Friday is fine.

amy_legal: ok, will send draft attestation and NDA text by 5pm.

marie_sales: great — i'll follow up with Alex and close loop here. thanks team :pray:
